description:
*“Mr. Jung, shall I tell you a story? Something like a fairy tale. A long time ago, there lived a servant named Geol-Son and a nobleman named Jo Moon-Young. The two of them fell in love at first sight…but their story ends in tragedy.”* 

Two lovers, reborn in the modern age, are once again separated by fate; Jo Moon-Young, now Lee Han-Young, is the cold and calculating CEO of SB Construction - the same company that is trying to destroy Jung Seok-Hyun’s neighborhood. But when the two come face to face, Han-Young realizes that Seok-Hyun is the very man who haunts his dreams: the reincarnation of Geol-Son. Convinced that this is his chance to correct the mistakes of his past and hold his forbidden lover in his arms one more, Moon-Young will do whatever it takes to rewrite their fated destiny in pursuit of a brighter future together.

(Source: Lezhin US)
